cases.name: inherited defaults and exposed identity
cases.source:
class Base:
 def f(self,value=2,*,scale=3):return value*scale
class Child(Base):pass
obj=Child()
print(obj.f(),obj.f(4,scale=5),Child.f(obj,3),obj.f.__self__ is obj,obj.f.__func__ is Base.f,obj.f is obj.f)

cases.name: binding precedes arguments
cases.source:
class C:
 def run(self,value):return 'old'+value
def replacement(self,value):return 'new'+value
c=C()
def change():
 C.run=replacement
 c.run=lambda value:'own'+value
 return ':value'
print(c.run(change()),c.run(':later'),C.run(c,':class'))
